LanguageData.DS_AdjustSweepDesc: Set the sweep direction and full angular width. Move the mouse to aim; middle-click to toggle angle adjustment; left-click to apply; right-click or Escape to cancel. Hold Ctrl to show cells the beam can reach through the current obstacles.
LanguageData.DS_SweepEditorHelp: Mouse: direction · Middle-click: adjust angle · Left-click: apply · Right-click/Esc: cancel · Ctrl: reachable cells
LanguageData.DS_SweepWidthHelp: Move toward the light to narrow the sector or away to widen it. Middle-click to lock the width · Left-click to apply · Right-click/Esc to cancel · Ctrl for reachable cells
LanguageData.DS_AssignmentPolicyDesc: Choose how the selected searchlights share targets in Sweep and Automatic modes. Independent keeps the original targeting behavior. Spread favors reachable targets that other lights have left unassigned. Concentrate allows lights to share their preferred target.
LanguageData.DS_DetectionAlertsDesc: Choose how the selected searchlights report new hostile detections in Sweep and Automatic modes.
